description: This file contains JavaScript functions that provide client-side API calls related to user data management in the application. It includes functions to fetch user projects and minimal user info utilizing an abstracted API client.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a user's projects from the backend, accepting user ID and optional query parameters such as organization, date range, and tenant ID.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId)
methods.description: Fetches minimal user information (ID and name) based on a MongoDB ObjectId, with error handling for not found cases.
